entries.answer:
Asuka’s first high-profile green mist use in WWE was on Nikki Cross during *Hell in a Cell* on October 6, 2019, when the Kabuki Warriors won the Women’s Tag Team Championship. That moment is widely treated as the start of her mist-spitting heel run on WWE television.[1][2]

## What happened
The finish came when Asuka spat the green mist into Nikki Cross’s face, blinding her and helping set up the title change for Asuka and Kairi Sane. Coverage of the match and WWE highlight pages describe it as a sudden, ruthless attack that marked a major character shift.[2][1]

## Why it matters
Before this, Asuka was known for her technical skill and striking, but the mist gave her a more sinister signature move in WWE. It also connected her to a long wrestling tradition of “Asian mist,” especially associated with wrestlers like Tajiri and other mist users.[3][4]

## Later uses
After that first WWE mist spot, Asuka used green or poison mist in other matches and storylines, including attacks on Paige and Becky Lynch. WWE later continued to feature it in newer feuds as one of her most recognizable weapons.[5][6]
